column1: # ebusd configuration for Wolf CGU-2K-18 gas combi boiler with Wolf ART room controller
# Device identification: the boiler answers 0704 with manufacturer 0x40 (ENCON) and a non-ASCII device ID

column2: no SW/HW version). ebusd therefore reports ID "" and picks encon/08.csv.

column1: # Status of each value (see docs/): confirmed = verified by tests; probable = consistent observations
# All 5022 reads are plain "r" (read on demand). See config/README.md for a recommended polling setup.
# Names contain temp/status/power/mode/timer/hours/starts so that the default ebusd mqtt-hassio.cfg filter passes them.

column2: 30 = gas valves. Mode 3/5 = start phase steps (exact meaning open).

column14: 0 off / 3 + 5 start phase / 6 ignition / 7 burner on / 8 fault / 10 shutdown phase
column20: bit field: 01 always / 04 hot water / 08 flame / 30 gas valves / 40 pump / 80 fault
column26: burner power relative to the allowed maximum (HG04 heating / HG03 hot water)

column1: # 0800 boiler -> ART (03 -> f1). Confirmed: BoilerTempSetpoint = HG08 - HG01
# Probable: OutsideTemp (-40 = no outside sensor connected).

column14: HG08 minus HG01 (5 after power-up for ~40 s; 40 in chimney sweep mode)
column32: bit field: 01 hot water incl. ~60 s run-on / 02 heating active / 04 hot water draw detected / 08 no heat demand (input E1 open) / 10 burner off / 20+40 chimney sweep mode
column38: hot water setpoint (echo of ART P03)

column2: every ~10 s. Standard eBUS "burner operational data": status (bb hot water + heating / aa heating only)

column1: # boiler target temperature (A01 - the boiler limits with HG08)

column14: bb hot water + heating / aa heating only (chimney sweep mode)

column2: every ~10 s. Standard eBUS layout "target values of the room controller":

column20: outside temperature field (90) / forced performance / status bits

column1: # fe01 error code from the boiler
column2: sent only when the error state changes (not at start-up). Text e.g. "E008"

column1: # Text fields are not passed to Home Assistant by the default mqtt-hassio.cfg - use ErrorStatus (5022 0x0001) there.
# Request: xx LL HH = 16-bit number HHLL little-endian
column2: first byte ignored (00 used here). Answer: 2 bytes little-endian.

column4: flow temperature 1 (A02 on the ART; confirmed)
flow temperature 2 near the heat exchanger (5022 0x0358; probable - 1-2 K warmer at standstill)
hot water temperature (5022 0x0359; confirmed - follows P03 while drawing hot water)
outside temperature (5022 0x000c; probable - -40 = no sensor connected)
current error code (5022 0x0001; confirmed - 0 = no error)

column1: # Parameters HG01-HG17 (confirmed by the ART read order = menu order and by changing values on the ART)

column4: HG02 lower burner power heating - raw 0-255 = 0-100 % (5022 0x015a)
HG03 upper burner power hot water - raw 0-255 = 0-100 % (5022 0x0159)
HG04 upper burner power heating - raw 0-255 = 0-100 % (5022 0x013f)
HG08 maximum boiler temperature heating TV-max (5022 0x0027)
HG16 heating circuit pump power minimum (5022 0x0155)
HG17 heating circuit pump power maximum (5022 0x0156)
operating hours mains on (5022 0x0228; confirmed - +1 per hour)

column1: # Error history HG80-89: 10 entries of 2 words in 0x022b-0x023e
column2: newest last. Only the newest entry is defined here.
